title: Pig waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="28" ry="22" fill="#f7a8b8"/>
  <!-- lighter belly shade -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="20" ry="15" fill="#ffc4d0"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="82" width="9" height="12" rx="4" fill="#e8919f"/>
  <rect x="61" y="82" width="9" height="12" rx="4" fill="#e8919f"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="30" y="90" width="9" height="4" rx="2" fill="#d47387"/>
  <rect x="61" y="90" width="9" height="4" rx="2" fill="#d47387"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="24" fill="#f7a8b8"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="22" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#e8919f" transform="rotate(-25 32 22)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="22" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#e8919f" transform="rotate(25 68 22)"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="23" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffc4d0" transform="rotate(-25 33 23)"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="23" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffc4d0" transform="rotate(25 67 23)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="38" r="4" fill="#4a2a33"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="38" r="4" fill="#4a2a33"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="36.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="36.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#e8919f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="12" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#d47387" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="52" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#4a2a33"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="52" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#4a2a33"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 62 Q50 68 58 62" fill="none" stroke="#d47387" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="50" r="5" fill="#ff8fa8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="50" r="5" fill="#ff8fa8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <g transform="rotate(-35 74 58)">
    <rect x="72" y="40" width="8" height="22" rx="4" fill="#f7a8b8"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="38" r="6" fill="#f7a8b8"/>
    <!-- hoof/hand -->
    <circle cx="76" cy="34" r="5" fill="#d47387"/>
  </g>
  <!-- motion lines near waving hand -->
  <path d="M85 28 Q89 25 88 20" fill="none" stroke="#ffd6e0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M88 33 Q93 31 94 26" fill="none" stroke="#ffd6e0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <rect x="22" y="62" width="8" height="16" rx="4" fill="#f7a8b8"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="78" r="5" fill="#d47387"/>
</svg>
